trial_court: Family Court, Janjgir, District: Janjgir-Champa Chhattisgarh (Civil Suit No. 52-A/2021)
case_name: Smt. Lalita Patel vs Jitendra Patel
facts_of_case: Marriage of the petitioner and respondent solemnized on 06.05.2017. Dispute took place between them, and after the dispute the petitioner started to reside at Bilaspur in her parental house. Respondent filed an application under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Family Court.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another forum if the applicant is unable to attend proceedings due to financial constraints.
legal_principles.held: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, considering the fact that the applicant is a lady, looking to her health condition and also considering the fact that she is residing in her parental house at District: Bilaspur (C.G.) which is 50 kms far away from the Family Court, Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh.

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the health condition of an applicant when deciding whether to transfer a case.

outcome.final_order: The case filed by the respondent/husband pending before Family Court, Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh may be transferred to Family Court, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.
